_meta.source: TMG 浸水予想区域図 (東京都建設局) — inundation depth point grids, 14 river-basin zones
_meta.attribution: 出典：東京都建設局 浸水予想区域図（東京都オープンデータカタログサイト）
_meta.scenario: 想定最大規模 (maximum assumed scale)
_meta.notes: Depth is continuous (not banded), from both 外水氾濫 (river overflow) and 内水氾濫 (inland/drainage flooding). Official zones understate — real flooding can exceed the model (MLIT caveat). The SRTM<5 m proxy remains as elevation display; only the flood dealbreaker moved.
